description: A dataset of summer surface water distribution in Qinghai Province based on multi-source data (2019–2023) 基于多源数据的青海省夏季地表水分布数据集（2019–2023） is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Xia Xingsheng, Feng Xinyi (Qinghai Normal University). This study, based on the Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud platform, utilizes Sentinel-1 data, Sentinel-2 data, and a digital elevation model combined with a threshold segmentation method to extract the summer surface water distribution data (including water bodies and glacial snow) in Qinghai Province from 2019 to 2023. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 257740258 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
